# Amherstburg Heating & Cooling

> Amherstburg Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Amherstburg, Essex County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 918-5036  |  Email: contact@amherstburgheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://amherstburgheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Amherstburg, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex
